content.text: give me 3 random agents , then tell me how many users in the app, then finally give me the mail of the admin
I'll help you with those three requests. Let me start by pulling up the manual for account lookups to get random agents

context_diary: The account_lookup function can retrieve random samples by specifying type and limit without specific IDs. The generate_aggregation_report function provides counts across account types when using metric "count" with group_by "type" parameter. Admin accounts are queryable as a distinct type. The system distinguishes between USER, AGENT, and ADMIN account types with separate counts. When querying without specific identifiers, the system returns random samples from the pool. The aggregation function name is generate_aggregation_report, not aggregation_reporting.
